page.layout: One printed page: a framed engraved frontispiece with the title printed in italic capitals in the lower left over the image; no running text. A small signature mark "h" lower right, outside the frame.
page.notes: Engraving: an allegorical frontispiece showing a landscape with an easel and painted panel at upper left, a rocky outcrop with figures, a classical doorway/gate at upper right, and a group of scholars at lower right among books, with book spines labelled "Organon Aristotelis", "Patristica" and "Opera" (partly illegible), a cat and globes. The title lines are set in italic capitals on the image. The lower-right letter "h" is a printed signature mark of the plate. Bottom-right faint "Google" digitiser credit is excluded.
